name: diff-table
title: Diff Table
summary: Changes an agent proposes to a table, accepted or rejected row by row.
description: Edits an agent proposes to tabular data, reviewed row by row before they are applied. Each changed row is the control: click it, or focus its include box and press Enter / Space, to include or exclude that addition or removal before applying. A native table; the checkbox role sits on the include box inside each changed row.

anatomy.description: max-width 380; data-enter once painted (an added row reveals only after that)
Gone once applied, and when no row changes
One per column (name, category, value); its width is the recipe col variant
data-key; its change (removed|added|unchanged), included and toggleable state are recipe variants

Its column (name|category|value) is a recipe variant. The category is a status-pill (tone neutral, size sm) whose dot takes the row tone through dotTone (data-dot-tone=accent|orange|green; none for neutral)
Added rows only: the reveal wrapper of each cell (grid 0fr → 1fr on mount)
Added rows only: the cell padding, inside the clipping child of reveal
Value text + include box (a checkbox: size md, tone red for a removal / green for an addition, aria-label on its input, roving tabindex on the inputs; disabled once applied)
Truncates at the end; full value in title
No rows: one cell across the columns (in a plain tr) holding the real EmptyState (size block, icon table, labels.empty). With no changed row, Apply is not offered
The real StatusPill (tone green, with a mark), marked data-diff-table="applied", after apply; pops in and takes focus (tabindex=-1)

included.description: Record<key, boolean>; defaults to every changed row included

labels.description: { hint, remove, add, apply, removal, removals, addition, additions, edit, edits, applied, change, changes, empty }

keyboard: Tab reaches the include boxes once (roving tabindex), then the Apply button
Enter / Space toggle the focused row's edit
ArrowDown / ArrowUp move to the next / previous changed row; Home / End to the first / last
Enter / Space on Apply applies; focus moves to the applied pill
notes: The table keeps native semantics (table, th scope=col, tr, td). Each changed row holds a checkbox (the native input inside the checkbox component), named "Remove <name>" or "Add <name>", so a screen reader reads the row as a table row and the box as a checkbox.
The focus ring is the checkbox's own, on the include box, while it has keyboard focus.
After Apply the boxes stay readable but are disabled and leave the tab order.

motion: row tint, text colour and the category pill: colour / opacity over duration.base from the pointer; instant from the keyboard (kbd-instant), like the include box
row hover (toggleable rows, fine pointers): a 4% ink layer, instant both ways; the press darkens the fill beneath to 7% over duration.base
include box: the checkbox's own recipe (fill leads, the check is drawn, shorter exit)

added row: reveal recipe (grid-template-rows over duration.reveal, opacity over duration.base, through @starting-style) only for a row added after the table's first paint (data-enter on the root, lib/paint.ts); the rows it mounts with are simply there; no timers
applied pill: the status-pill's pop-in (mark) over duration.popup, once
Apply button: the button's own press
